title: Updating an address - support procedure
content: For the synthetic bank, use the profile-update menu or a verified branch, select the address field, and follow the displayed evidence checklist. A demo reviewer checks the request before marking it complete; never paste a real residential address here.
customer_content: Use the profile-update menu in your trusted banking app or visit a verified branch to request an address change. Follow the displayed document checklist and wait for review before treating the update as complete. Do not send a residential address through this conversation.
